body.p: I. Summary of Office Action and Reply
In the Office Action, the Office:
" Made the action non-final;
" Required election of a single disclosed species or a single grouping of
patentably indistinct species for the following 11 species, for prosecution
on the merits under 35 U.S.C. 121 to which the claims shall be restricted if
no generic claim is finally held to be allowable:

" Species I, drawn to Figs. 2-3, depicting an embodiment of a trailing edge high lift assembly having two actuators wherein the panel axis is located at the trailing edge end of a speed brake panel, and the speed brake panel is mounted to the leading edge portion of the trailing edge part. " Species II, drawn to Figs. 4-5, depicting an embodiment of a trailing edge high lift assembly having two actuators wherein the speed brake panel is mounted to the trailing edge portion of the leading edge part.

" Species III, drawn to Figs. 6-7, depicting an embodiment of a trailing edge high lift assembly having two actuators wherein the panel axis is located at the leading edge end of the speed brake panel, and the speed brake panel is mounted to the leading edge portion of the leading edge part. " Species IV, drawn to Fig. 8, depicting an embodiment of a trailing edge high lift assembly having three actuators, the third being a linear actuator connecting the leading edge part and the speed brake panel.

* Species VI, drawn to Figs. 10-12, depicting an embodiment of a trailing edge high lift assembly having two actuators and a third actuator in the form of an actuation mechanism for moving the speed brake panel between the stowed position and the deployed position by transferring movement of the trailing edge part relative to the le a ding edge part of the second actuator unit to the speed brake panel comprising a rocker link having a L-form, and a further link.

* Species VII, drawn to Figs. 13-14, depicting an embodiment of a trailing edge high lift assembly having two actuators and an actuation mechanism for moving the speed brake panel between the stowed position and the deployed position, wherein the panel axis is located at the leading edge of the speed brake panel and the speed brake panel is mounted to the leading edge portion of the leading edge part.

* Species VIII, drawn to Figs. 15-17, depicting an embodiment of a trailing edge high lift assembly having two actuators wherein the speed brake panel is mounted to the trailing edge portion of the leading edge part with a linkage distinct from the other species and a retraction spring.
* Species IX, drawn to Figs. 18-20, depicting an embodiment of a trailing edge high lift assembly having two actuators comprising a catch mechanism, a catch arm and a catch panel
provided at the speed brake panel for moving the speed brake panel.

" Species X, drawn to Figs. 21-22, depicting an embodiment of a trailing edge high lift assembly having two actuators comprising a cam mechanism, a cam, a cam track provided at the speed brake panel for moving the speed brake panel. " Species XI, drawn to Figs. 23, depicting an embodiment of a trailing edge high lift assembly having two actuators comprising a cam mechanism, a cam, a cam track provided at the speed brake panel for moving the speed brake panel, wherein the panel axis is located at the leading edge end of the speed brake panel, the speed brake panel is mounted to the leading edge portion of the leading edge part, and the cam mechanism is mounted to the trailing edge part. By this Reply:
" Election of Species VI is made without traverse;
" Applicant submits that Claims 1-6 and 8-15 read on the elected species;
" Claim 7 is withdrawn from consideration;
" No new matter is added; and
" Claims 1-6 and 8-15 are at issue.
Applicant submits the Application is now in condition for allowance and requests same.
II. Conclusion

In view of the foregoing amendments and remarks, Applicant respectfully submits that the Application is in condition for allowance. If deficiencies remain, Examiner may contact the undersigned to facilitate allowance of this case.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees which may be required to this application under 37 C.F.R. §§ 1.16-1.17, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 07-2069.
Respectfully submitted,
Dated: August 30, 2024 By: /PETER M. KLOBUCHAR/
